description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying its mana cost.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Phyrexian Dreadnought that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Phyrexian Dreadnought token instead.
